title: salix lanata richardsonii
intro: Salix lanata richardsonii, commonly known as Richardson's willow or lance-leaved willow, is a small deciduous shrub or tree native to the western regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which may help alleviate pain and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Salix lanata richardsonii include astringent and hemostatic properties, making it useful in wound care and as a treatment for diarrhea and dysentery. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
